blocks.source: Canto XIV
blocks.translation: Canto XIV

blocks.source: Poi che la carità del natio loco
blocks.translation: Because the charity of my native place

blocks.source: mi strinse, raunai le fronde sparte
blocks.translation: Constrained me, gathered I the scattered leaves,

blocks.source: e rende’le a colui, ch’era già fioco.
blocks.translation: And gave them back to him, who now was hoarse.

blocks.source: Indi venimmo al fine ove si parte
blocks.translation: Then came we to the confine, where disparted

blocks.source: lo secondo giron dal terzo, e dove
blocks.translation: The second round is from the third, and where

blocks.source: si vede di giustizia orribil arte.
blocks.translation: A horrible form of Justice is beheld.

blocks.source: A ben manifestar le cose nove,
blocks.translation: Clearly to manifest these novel things,

blocks.source: dico che arrivammo ad una landa
blocks.translation: I say that we arrived upon a plain,

blocks.source: che dal suo letto ogne pianta rimove.
blocks.translation: Which from its bed rejecteth every plant;

blocks.source: La dolorosa selva l’è ghirlanda
blocks.translation: The dolorous forest is a garland to it

blocks.source: intorno, come ’l fosso tristo ad essa;
blocks.translation: All round about, as the sad moat to that;

blocks.source: quivi fermammo i passi a randa a randa.
blocks.translation: There close upon the edge we stayed our feet.

blocks.source: Lo spazzo era una rena arida e spessa,
blocks.translation: The soil was of an arid and thick sand,

blocks.source: non d’altra foggia fatta che colei
blocks.translation: Not of another fashion made than that

blocks.source: che fu da’ piè di Caton già soppressa.
blocks.translation: Which by the feet of Cato once was pressed.

blocks.source: O vendetta di Dio, quanto tu dei
blocks.translation: Vengeance of God, O how much oughtest thou

blocks.source: esser temuta da ciascun che legge
blocks.translation: By each one to be dreaded, who doth read

blocks.source: ciò che fu manifesto a li occhi mei!
blocks.translation: That which was manifest unto mine eyes!

blocks.source: D’anime nude vidi molte gregge
blocks.translation: Of naked souls beheld I many herds,

blocks.source: che piangean tutte assai miseramente,
blocks.translation: Who all were weeping very miserably,

blocks.source: e parea posta lor diversa legge.
blocks.translation: And over them seemed set a law diverse.

blocks.source: Supin giacea in terra alcuna gente,
blocks.translation: Supine upon the ground some folk were lying;

blocks.source: alcuna si sedea tutta raccolta,
blocks.translation: And some were sitting all drawn up together,

blocks.source: e altra andava continüamente.
blocks.translation: And others went about continually.

blocks.source: Quella che giva ’ntorno era più molta,
blocks.translation: Those who were going round were far the more,

blocks.source: e quella men che giacëa al tormento,
blocks.translation: And those were less who lay down to their torment,

blocks.source: ma più al duolo avea la lingua sciolta.
blocks.translation: But had their tongues more loosed to lamentation.

blocks.source: Sovra tutto ’l sabbion, d’un cader lento,
blocks.translation: O’er all the sand-waste, with a gradual fall,

blocks.source: piovean di foco dilatate falde,
blocks.translation: Were raining down dilated flakes of fire,

blocks.source: come di neve in alpe sanza vento.
blocks.translation: As of the snow on Alp without a wind.

blocks.source: Quali Alessandro in quelle parti calde
blocks.translation: As Alexander, in those torrid parts

blocks.source: d’Indïa vide sopra ’l süo stuolo
blocks.translation: Of India, beheld upon his host

blocks.source: fiamme cadere infino a terra salde,
blocks.translation: Flames fall unbroken till they reached the ground.

blocks.source: per ch’ei provide a scalpitar lo suolo
blocks.translation: Whence he provided with his phalanxes

blocks.source: con le sue schiere, acciò che lo vapore
blocks.translation: To trample down the soil, because the vapour

blocks.source: mei si stingueva mentre ch’era solo:
blocks.translation: Better extinguished was while it was single;

blocks.source: tale scendeva l’etternale ardore;
blocks.translation: Thus was descending the eternal heat,

blocks.source: onde la rena s’accendea, com’ esca
blocks.translation: Whereby the sand was set on fire, like tinder

blocks.source: sotto focile, a doppiar lo dolore.
blocks.translation: Beneath the steel, for doubling of the dole.

blocks.source: Sanza riposo mai era la tresca
blocks.translation: Without repose forever was the dance

blocks.source: de le misere mani, or quindi or quinci
blocks.translation: Of miserable hands, now there, now here,

blocks.source: escotendo da sé l’arsura fresca.
blocks.translation: Shaking away from off them the fresh gleeds.

blocks.source: I’ cominciai: «Maestro, tu che vinci
blocks.translation: “Master,” began I, “thou who overcomest

blocks.source: tutte le cose, fuor che ’ demon duri
blocks.translation: All things except the demons dire, that issued

blocks.source: ch’a l’intrar de la porta incontra uscinci,
blocks.translation: Against us at the entrance of the gate,

blocks.source: chi è quel grande che non par che curi
blocks.translation: Who is that mighty one who seems to heed not

blocks.source: lo ’ncendio e giace dispettoso e torto,
blocks.translation: The fire, and lieth lowering and disdainful,

blocks.source: sì che la pioggia non par che ’l marturi?».
blocks.translation: So that the rain seems not to ripen him?”

blocks.source: E quel medesmo, che si fu accorto
blocks.translation: And he himself, who had become aware

blocks.source: ch’io domandava il mio duca di lui,
blocks.translation: That I was questioning my Guide about him,

blocks.source: gridò: «Qual io fui vivo, tal son morto.
blocks.translation: Cried: “Such as I was living, am I, dead.

blocks.source: Se Giove stanchi ’l suo fabbro da cui
blocks.translation: If Jove should weary out his smith, from whom

blocks.source: crucciato prese la folgore aguta
blocks.translation: He seized in anger the sharp thunderbolt,

blocks.source: onde l’ultimo dì percosso fui;
blocks.translation: Wherewith upon the last day I was smitten,

blocks.source: o s’elli stanchi li altri a muta a muta
blocks.translation: And if he wearied out by turns the others

blocks.source: in Mongibello a la focina negra,
blocks.translation: In Mongibello at the swarthy forge,

blocks.source: chiamando “Buon Vulcano, aiuta, aiuta!”,
blocks.translation: Vociferating, ‘Help, good Vulcan, help!’

blocks.source: sì com’ el fece a la pugna di Flegra,
blocks.translation: Even as he did there at the fight of Phlegra,

blocks.source: e me saetti con tutta sua forza:
blocks.translation: And shot his bolts at me with all his might,

blocks.source: non ne potrebbe aver vendetta allegra».
blocks.translation: He would not have thereby a joyous vengeance.”

blocks.source: Allora il duca mio parlò di forza
blocks.translation: Then did my Leader speak with such great force,

blocks.source: tanto, ch’i’ non l’avea sì forte udito:
blocks.translation: That I had never heard him speak so loud:

blocks.source: «O Capaneo, in ciò che non s’ammorza
blocks.translation: “O Capaneus, in that is not extinguished

blocks.source: la tua superbia, se’ tu più punito;
blocks.translation: Thine arrogance, thou punished art the more;

blocks.source: nullo martiro, fuor che la tua rabbia,
blocks.translation: Not any torment, saving thine own rage,

blocks.source: sarebbe al tuo furor dolor compito».
blocks.translation: Would be unto thy fury pain complete.”

blocks.source: Poi si rivolse a me con miglior labbia,
blocks.translation: Then he turned round to me with better lip,

blocks.source: dicendo: «Quei fu l’un d’i sette regi
blocks.translation: Saying: “One of the Seven Kings was he

blocks.source: ch’assiser Tebe; ed ebbe e par ch’elli abbia
blocks.translation: Who Thebes besieged, and held, and seems to hold

blocks.source: Dio in disdegno, e poco par che ’l pregi;
blocks.translation: God in disdain, and little seems to prize him;

blocks.source: ma, com’ io dissi lui, li suoi dispetti
blocks.translation: But, as I said to him, his own despites

blocks.source: sono al suo petto assai debiti fregi.
blocks.translation: Are for his breast the fittest ornaments.

blocks.source: Or mi vien dietro, e guarda che non metti,
blocks.translation: Now follow me, and mind thou do not place

blocks.source: ancor, li piedi ne la rena arsiccia;
blocks.translation: As yet thy feet upon the burning sand,

blocks.source: ma sempre al bosco tien li piedi stretti».
blocks.translation: But always keep them close unto the wood.”

blocks.source: Tacendo divenimmo là ’ve spiccia
blocks.translation: Speaking no word, we came to where there gushes

blocks.source: fuor de la selva un picciol fiumicello,
blocks.translation: Forth from the wood a little rivulet,

blocks.source: lo cui rossore ancor mi raccapriccia.
blocks.translation: Whose redness makes my hair still stand on end.

blocks.source: Quale del Bulicame esce ruscello
blocks.translation: As from the Bulicame springs the brooklet,

blocks.source: che parton poi tra lor le peccatrici,
blocks.translation: The sinful women later share among them,

blocks.source: tal per la rena giù sen giva quello.
blocks.translation: So downward through the sand it went its way.

blocks.source: Lo fondo suo e ambo le pendici
blocks.translation: The bottom of it, and both sloping banks,

blocks.source: fatt’ era ’n pietra, e ’ margini dallato;
blocks.translation: Were made of stone, and the margins at the side;

blocks.source: per ch’io m’accorsi che ’l passo era lici.
blocks.translation: Whence I perceived that there the passage was.

blocks.source: «Tra tutto l’altro ch’i’ t’ho dimostrato,
blocks.translation: “In all the rest which I have shown to thee

blocks.source: poscia che noi intrammo per la porta
blocks.translation: Since we have entered in within the gate

blocks.source: lo cui sogliare a nessuno è negato,
blocks.translation: Whose threshold unto no one is denied,

blocks.source: cosa non fu da li tuoi occhi scorta
blocks.translation: Nothing has been discovered by thine eyes

blocks.source: notabile com’ è ’l presente rio,
blocks.translation: So notable as is the present river,

blocks.source: che sovra sé tutte fiammelle ammorta».
blocks.translation: Which all the little flames above it quenches.”

blocks.source: Queste parole fuor del duca mio;
blocks.translation: These words were of my Leader; whence I prayed him

blocks.source: per ch’io ’l pregai che mi largisse ’l pasto
blocks.translation: That he would give me largess of the food,

blocks.source: di cui largito m’avëa il disio.
blocks.translation: For which he had given me largess of desire.

blocks.source: «In mezzo mar siede un paese guasto»,
blocks.translation: “In the mid-sea there sits a wasted land,”

blocks.source: diss’ elli allora, «che s’appella Creta,
blocks.translation: Said he thereafterward, “whose name is Crete,

blocks.source: sotto ’l cui rege fu già ’l mondo casto.
blocks.translation: Under whose king the world of old was chaste.

blocks.source: Una montagna v’è che già fu lieta
blocks.translation: There is a mountain there, that once was glad

blocks.source: d’acqua e di fronde, che si chiamò Ida;
blocks.translation: With waters and with leaves, which was called Ida;

blocks.source: or è diserta come cosa vieta.
blocks.translation: Now ’tis deserted, as a thing worn out.

blocks.source: Rëa la scelse già per cuna fida
blocks.translation: Rhea once chose it for the faithful cradle

blocks.source: del suo figliuolo, e per celarlo meglio,
blocks.translation: Of her own son; and to conceal him better,

blocks.source: quando piangea, vi facea far le grida.
blocks.translation: Whene’er he cried, she there had clamours made.

blocks.source: Dentro dal monte sta dritto un gran veglio,
blocks.translation: A grand old man stands in the mount erect,

blocks.source: che tien volte le spalle inver’ Dammiata
blocks.translation: Who holds his shoulders turned tow’rds Damietta,

blocks.source: e Roma guarda come süo speglio.
blocks.translation: And looks at Rome as if it were his mirror.

blocks.source: La sua testa è di fin oro formata,
blocks.translation: His head is fashioned of refined gold,

blocks.source: e puro argento son le braccia e ’l petto,
blocks.translation: And of pure silver are the arms and breast;

blocks.source: poi è di rame infino a la forcata;
blocks.translation: Then he is brass as far down as the fork.

blocks.source: da indi in giuso è tutto ferro eletto,
blocks.translation: From that point downward all is chosen iron,

blocks.source: salvo che ’l destro piede è terra cotta;
blocks.translation: Save that the right foot is of kiln-baked clay,

blocks.source: e sta ’n su quel, più che ’n su l’altro, eretto.
blocks.translation: And more he stands on that than on the other.

blocks.source: Ciascuna parte, fuor che l’oro, è rotta
blocks.translation: Each part, except the gold, is by a fissure

blocks.source: d’una fessura che lagrime goccia,
blocks.translation: Asunder cleft, that dripping is with tears,

blocks.source: le quali, accolte, fóran quella grotta.
blocks.translation: Which gathered together perforate that cavern.

blocks.source: Lor corso in questa valle si diroccia;
blocks.translation: From rock to rock they fall into this valley;

blocks.source: fanno Acheronte, Stige e Flegetonta;
blocks.translation: Acheron, Styx, and Phlegethon they form;

blocks.source: poi sen van giù per questa stretta doccia,
blocks.translation: Then downward go along this narrow sluice

blocks.source: infin, là ove più non si dismonta,
blocks.translation: Unto that point where is no more descending.

blocks.source: fanno Cocito; e qual sia quello stagno
blocks.translation: They form Cocytus; what that pool may be

blocks.source: tu lo vedrai, però qui non si conta».
blocks.translation: Thou shalt behold, so here ’tis not narrated.”

blocks.source: E io a lui: «Se ’l presente rigagno
blocks.translation: And I to him: “If so the present runnel

blocks.source: si diriva così dal nostro mondo,
blocks.translation: Doth take its rise in this way from our world,

blocks.source: perché ci appar pur a questo vivagno?».
blocks.translation: Why only on this verge appears it to us?”

blocks.source: Ed elli a me: «Tu sai che ’l loco è tondo;
blocks.translation: And he to me: “Thou knowest the place is round,

blocks.source: e tutto che tu sie venuto molto,
blocks.translation: And notwithstanding thou hast journeyed far,

blocks.source: pur a sinistra, giù calando al fondo,
blocks.translation: Still to the left descending to the bottom,

blocks.source: non se’ ancor per tutto ’l cerchio vòlto;
blocks.translation: Thou hast not yet through all the circle turned.

blocks.source: per che, se cosa n’apparisce nova,
blocks.translation: Therefore if something new appear to us,

blocks.source: non de’ addur maraviglia al tuo volto».
blocks.translation: It should not bring amazement to thy face.”

blocks.source: E io ancor: «Maestro, ove si trova
blocks.translation: And I again: “Master, where shall be found

blocks.source: Flegetonta e Letè? ché de l’un taci,
blocks.translation: Lethe and Phlegethon, for of one thou’rt silent,

blocks.source: e l’altro di’ che si fa d’esta piova».
blocks.translation: And sayest the other of this rain is made?”

blocks.source: «In tutte tue question certo mi piaci»,
blocks.translation: “In all thy questions truly thou dost please me,”

blocks.source: rispuose, «ma ’l bollor de l’acqua rossa
blocks.translation: Replied he; “but the boiling of the red

blocks.source: dovea ben solver l’una che tu faci.
blocks.translation: Water might well solve one of them thou makest.

blocks.source: Letè vedrai, ma fuor di questa fossa,
blocks.translation: Thou shalt see Lethe, but outside this moat,

blocks.source: là dove vanno l’anime a lavarsi
blocks.translation: There where the souls repair to lave themselves,

blocks.source: quando la colpa pentuta è rimossa».
blocks.translation: When sin repented of has been removed.”

blocks.source: Poi disse: «Omai è tempo da scostarsi
blocks.translation: Then said he: “It is time now to abandon

blocks.source: dal bosco; fa che di retro a me vegne:
blocks.translation: The wood; take heed that thou come after me;

blocks.source: li margini fan via, che non son arsi,
blocks.translation: A way the margins make that are not burning,

blocks.source: e sopra loro ogne vapor si spegne».
blocks.translation: And over them all vapours are extinguished.”
